messages.text:
Still no reachable server, and Vite is not printing a useful error through Playwright.

I’m going to launch the exact dev command as a tracked process, poll the port, read its log, and then stop only that process id.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$out=Join-Path (Resolve-Path .) '"'dev-server.log'; if(Test-Path "'$out){Remove-Item $out -Force}; $p=Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList @('"'scripts/run-with-esbuild.mjs','vite','--host','127.0.0.1','--port','4178') -WorkingDirectory (Resolve-Path .) -RedirectStandardOutput "'$out -RedirectStandardError $out -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep -Seconds 8; try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://127.0.0.1:4178 -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5 | Select-Object StatusCode,Content } catch { $_ | Out-String }; Get-Content $out -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force'
